rules.entry: At daily close: close > SMA200 including current close AND close > maximum High of the previous 20 completed days, excluding current day.
rules.exit: At daily close: close < SMA200 OR close < minimum Low of previous 10 completed days, excluding current day.
rules.execution: Signals from day t execute at day t+1 open, adjusted adversely for slippage plus fee on each fill.
rules.position: Long or cash, one position, no leverage, no shorting. Entire simulated balance per entry for an explicit comparable research baseline, not a real-money sizing recommendation.
rules.terminal: Liquidate any remaining position at final daily close, with both slippage and fee. Tag forced terminal exits separately.
rules.benchmark: Buy and hold from first evaluated open to last close, same fees and slippage. Cash benchmark has zero interest.

cost_note: Assumed sensitivity scenarios, not verified user fee tiers. Slippage includes a simple adverse execution allowance; no order-book simulation. Operating cost shown separately at USD120/year, before tax.
window_note: Each window resets to cash; warmup uses only preceding dates. Chronological evaluation, not a statistically blind holdout. 2026 snapshots were already inspected in the earlier pilot. No parameter sweep or after-result tuning is authorized by this protocol.

screen.meaning: Provisional engineering screen for whether further paper observation is worth considering; not a significance test, guarantee or capital authorization.

limits: No annualization of a promised profit
